snippet.title: Flamefall Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
This is an early prototype of our upcoming horror RTT Flamefall. It's a real time tactics horror game where you play as a team of four - venturing into the dark woods, searching  for the Altar of Flame that you need to reignite with your personal flame spirit: Ignis. 

Our goal is to build a roguelike horror RTT that feels like a mashup of Aliens: Dark Descent, Darkwood and FTL. We'd love for you to come on this journey with us and give us feedback as we build the game! Please join our Discord as well.

We'll update the game as often as we can and keep you posted whenever we do!

This game was built by a small team, working at Funday Games, the developers of Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor and Wild Indigo Ranch.

- Anders, Game Director

Funday Website: https://www.fundaygames.dk/
Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321470/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Survivor/
Wild Indigo Ranch on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751350/Wild_Indigo_Ranch/
